description: Conversion of garage to habitable room
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (CEA19/AR/001; CEA19/AR/002; CEA19/AR/003; CEA19/AR/004; CEA19/AR/005 Received:  08 April 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Within 6 months of the date of this decision either the proposed staircase shall be installed and evidence of its construction provided to the Local Planning Authority or a timescale of proposed works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The staircase must be retained for the lifetime of the development.
